complaints.title: Severe 1.5ft crater pothole causing two-wheeler skids on 100ft Road
complaints.area: Indiranagar 100 Feet Road, near Metro Pillar 42
complaints.description: Deep road depression of approx 1.5ft depth right after heavy rainfall. Three two-wheelers skidded this morning during rush hour. Immediate hot-mix asphalt patching and reflective barricading required.

aiScreening.aiSummary: Computer Vision detected deep asphalt crater (>35cm) on primary arterial road. High vehicle accident probability; escalated to Rapid Road Squad.

timeline.note: Complaint filed by Kusuma Devi with live camera evidence and GPS coordinates.
CivicMind AI Vision classified as Level-1 Critical Pothole (98% confidence) and suggested Road and Infrastructure Department.
Zonal Officer Eng. Anita Desai verified AI screening and approved emergency SLA.
Assigned to RID Rapid Action Squad #3 (Indiranagar Zone).
Barricades placed; cold-milling and hot-mix asphalt laying underway.

complaints.officerRemarks: Jet-patcher machine deployed on site. Half lane cordoned off safely.

complaints.title: Main Cauvery drinking water pipeline burst flooding 80ft Road junction
complaints.area: Koramangala 4th Block, Sony World Signal Junction
complaints.description: High-pressure underground potable water feeder pipe ruptured, gushing thousands of liters of clean drinking water onto the intersection and threatening adjacent basement parking.

aiScreening.aiSummary: Agentic AI merged 3 nearby reports within 180m radius at Sony World Junction into master ticket #CM-2082.

timeline.note: Reported by citizen Aditya Narayan Rao with geo-tagged photo.
AI de-duplication engine linked 2 duplicate reports and flagged Critical priority.
Verified by BWSSB Control Room Officer.
Assigned to BWSSB Valve Control & Heavy Excavation Crew #4.

complaints.officerRemarks: Isolation valve closed to prevent water wastage. Excavation JCB arriving shortly.

complaints.title: Malfunctioning AI traffic signal stuck in amber blink causing 2km gridlock
complaints.area: Whitefield Main Road, Hope Farm Junction
complaints.description: All four directional signalheads at Hope Farm Circle are stuck in reboot loop during peak IT office commute. School buses and ambulances are trapped in severe gridlock.

aiScreening.aiSummary: AI detected controller relay fault on high-density IT corridor. Auto-pinged Traffic Command Center & Whitefield Ward Marshall.

timeline.note: Citizen emergency submission with live traffic snapshot.
Categorized under Traffic and road safety (Critical SLA: 4 hours).

complaints.title: Overflowing underground sewage manhole contaminating residential lane
complaints.description: Main sewage chamber choked with silt and plastic debris, causing untreated blackwater to overflow across the street outside apartments and clinics.

aiScreening.aiSummary: Classified as high-severity sewage overflow. Recommended Super-Sucker robotic jetting truck dispatch.

timeline.note: Submitted with geolocation and visual evidence.
AI routed to Drainage and Sewerage Department.
Verified by Marathahalli Zonal Engineer.
Assigned to Robotic Jetting Unit DSD-12.
High-pressure suction & line clearing in progress.

complaints.officerRemarks: Silt blockage at 12ft depth identified. Jetting machine clearing the conduit.

complaints.title: Uncollected commercial garbage blackspot near 8th Cross flower market
complaints.description: Accumulation of wet market waste and plastic packaging on footpath obstructing pedestrians and attracting stray cattle.

aiScreening.aiSummary: Vision model detected >2 tons of unsegregated solid waste on public right-of-way.

timeline.note: Logged via Citizen Mobile Web.
Auto-tagged for SWM Compactor Truck.
Verified by Dr. Arindam Bose (SWM).
Assigned to Compactor Fleet SWM-09.
Waste clearance & bio-enzyme sanitization spray underway.

complaints.officerRemarks: 80% cleared; installing AI solar CCTV camera to prevent repeat midnight dumping.

complaints.title: 6 consecutive smart LED streetlights dark along Electronic City Phase 1
complaints.area: Electronic City Phase 1, Neeladri Road Avenue
complaints.description: Entire 300-meter stretch on Neeladri Road is pitch dark due to feeder pillar fault. Unsafe for late-evening IT commuters and pedestrians.

aiScreening.aiSummary: Detected dark corridor on Women Safety Priority Route. Recommended immediate electrical feeder inspection.

timeline.note: Citizen night patrol report.
AI routed to Street Lighting and Electrical Department.

complaints.title: Deep waterlogging and damaged service road near Hebbal Flyover loop
complaints.area: Hebbal Flyover Airport Service Road, Esteem Mall Side
complaints.description: Broken storm drain grate and eroded asphalt causing severe bottleneck for airport-bound buses and cabs.

aiScreening.aiSummary: Categorized as high-priority road & storm-grate repair on NH-44 Airport Corridor.

timeline.note: Submitted with dashcam photo.
AI assigned High priority.
Verified by North Zone Engineer.
Assigned to North Highway Maintenance Unit.
Precast RCC drain slab installation in progress.

complaints.officerRemarks: Drain grate replaced; wet-mix macadam leveling underway.

complaints.title: Fallen gulmohar tree branch cleared from Jayanagar 4th Block park walkway
complaints.area: Jayanagar 4th Block, Madhavan Park East Gate
complaints.description: Heavy branch snapped during overnight windstorm blocking the senior citizen walking track and damaging an ornamental lamp post.

aiScreening.aiSummary: Routed to Horticulture & Urban Forestry Rapid Saw Team.

timeline.note: Morning walker complaint with photo.
Routed to Parks and Public Spaces Department.
Verified by Jayanagar Horticulture Officer.
Assigned to Tree Pruning Squad PPS-04.
Branch sectioned and loaded into green-waste shredder truck.
Walkway cleared, swept, and certified safe for walkers.

complaints.officerRemarks: Completed within 9 hours of reporting. Green waste sent to biomulch facility.
complaints.resolutionNotes: Tree branch removed, lamp post restored, and pathway sanitized.
complaints.feedback: Outstanding response! By evening walk time, the entire track was spotless and safe for senior citizens.

complaints.title: Low water supply pressure and muddy inflow in Rajajinagar 3rd Block
complaints.description: Tap water showed turbidity during morning supply window due to minor valve seal wear.

aiScreening.aiSummary: Routed to BWSSB Water Quality & Valve Maintenance Unit.

timeline.note: Reported by resident Venkatesh Murthy.
Routed to Water Supply Department.
Water quality lab team dispatched.
Assigned to Rajajinagar Sub-Division Crew.
Gasket replaced and line flushed with chlorine.
TDS and clarity verified normal (TDS 110 ppm).

complaints.officerRemarks: Pipeline flushed and residual chlorine tested safe.
complaints.resolutionNotes: Valve seal replaced and water quality certified by mobile lab.
complaints.feedback: Crystal clear water restored the very next morning. Appreciate the lab test report uploaded on the portal!

complaints.title: Lake bund solar lighting and aeration fountain restored at Yelahanka Lake
complaints.area: Yelahanka New Town Lake Bund Walkway
complaints.description: Two solar inverter poles and lake aerator timer needed recalibration on the northern eco-walkway.

aiScreening.aiSummary: Routed to Lake Rejuvenation & Solar Maintenance Cell.

timeline.note: Reported by Yelahanka Lake Walkers Association.
AI routed to Environmental Management Department.
Verified by Lake Conservation Officer.
Assigned to Solar & Aeration Tech Team.
Battery charge controller replaced.
All solar lamps and aerators functioning at 100%.

complaints.officerRemarks: Preventive check completed on all 28 solar poles around the lake.
complaints.resolutionNotes: Solar charge controller replaced and lake aerator schedule synchronized.
complaints.feedback: Yelahanka Lake walkway looks magical and well-lit again. Great job by CivicMind and the Environment team!
